audit.note: Recomputations verify saved data consistency, not global optimality; separate from optimization budget.

budget_revision: None; proposed budgets retained after runtime pilot.
objective: maximize weighted unique coverage - 0.1 * total power; infeasible candidates rejected by primary SA
constraints: Full per-case definitions above specify bounds, 3D minimum separation, GCS connectivity, communication radius, power and coverage parameters.

initialization.rules: Choose anchor uniformly from GCS and placed UAVs. For each nonfixed x/y/z axis draw uniform(-r_comm,r_comm) about anchor; fixed axes consume no draw. Short-circuit bounds, anchor distance, then prior-UAV separation checks in order. Append valid point; restart partial fleet before attempt multiples of 500. Score complete fleet once.
initialization.check_unit: One executed scalar axis-bound or 3D pair-distance test; count short-circuited checks only when executed.

neighborhood.fallback_reason: Approved simpler distribution: coordinated operator not implemented or verified.
neighborhood.rng: Each run uses independent random.Random(integer_seed). Every SA candidate, including calibration: random()<0.8 chooses 3d, otherwise altitude; randrange(N) chooses UAV; uniform(-1,1) for each moved axis x,y,z or z, including fixed axes. Multiply by scale*axis_range; reflect. No construction failure, retries or preliminary search rejection. Full evaluation of every proposal. Infeasible rejection consumes no acceptance draw; feasible delta>=0 consumes no acceptance draw; delta<0 consumes one random() for exp(delta/T). Calibration consumes no acceptance draws. Ties accepted; best updates only on strict improvement.

temperature.calibration: Neighbors of unchanged initial state; mean strictly downhill feasible score loss / -log(0.8), fallback 1.0, then multiplier. Calibration candidates can improve best feasible archive. Reserve at least one search evaluation.
temperature.cooling: T_j=T0*0.01**(j/(Bsearch-1)), j=0..Bsearch-1 evaluated search candidates. For Bsearch=1 use T0; for zero record insufficient_search_budget. Infeasible candidates advance j.

baseline_sampling: Same seeded constructive initialization and one full initial evaluation as SA. No calibration. Each remaining evaluation samples all UAVs independently uniform in each x,y,z bound, in UAV/axis order, including fixed axes; no resampling on infeasibility. Keep best feasible including initialization.

runtime.packages: Python standard library only; run with -B -S
